name: pydeseq2
description: PyDESeq2 is a third-party bulk RNA-seq differential-expression tool primitive for formula-based designs, Wald tests, FDR control, and optional LFC shrinkage. Use it for replicate-aware condition comparisons on raw count matrices rather than per-cell marker testing.
capabilities: Fit DESeq2-style models on bulk count matrices and sample metadata.
Evaluate formula-based designs, explicit contrasts, and multiple testing correction.
Support optional log fold-change shrinkage for ranking and plotting.
Export interpretable result tables for replicate-aware condition comparisons.
requirements: Raw integer count matrix with samples as rows and genes as columns.
Sample metadata with an explicit design formula and contrast definition.
